entry.title: Prophetic 0.1.0
entry.summary: The Korg Prophecy's synthesis, built on your computer from your own Prophecy v2.0 ROMs: their DSP programs and sound-engine firmware, translated to C++. 128 programs, every parameter, Performance Editor, arpeggiator, 1-8 voices. Gen2; tested on an MPC Live III.
